sourceComment: Based on Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan (MOFA) Short-Term Tourism criteria. Consular rules change periodically and must always be cross-verified with official MOFA sources.

requirements.description: Passport must be valid for the entire duration of stay in Japan.
requirements.whyRequired: MOFA requires travel document validity covering all declared days in Japan.

requirements.description: Bank balance certificate or 3-month statement showing adequate funds (approx. 100,000 JPY per week of stay).
requirements.whyRequired: Demonstrates ability to pay all travel, accommodation, and living costs in Japan.

requirements.description: Daily schedule of stay (Schedule of Stay) aligning with confirmed flights and hotel bookings.
requirements.whyRequired: Japanese consulates require daily planned activity sheets with hotel addresses and telephone numbers.

requirements.description: Names across hotel vouchers and airline tickets must match passport spelling precisely.
requirements.whyRequired: Japan Immigration enforces strict passenger manifest cross-checks.

requirements.description: 45mm x 35mm photograph taken within the last 6 months against a plain white background.
requirements.whyRequired: Strict adherence to Japanese consular dimensions; glossy finish required.
